description: This source file defines the 'Details' feature in the Articles module, including a query class, validator, and handler to retrieve article details by slug.

classes.name: Details.Query
classes.description: Represents the request for article details identified by a slug.

classes.name: Details.QueryValidator
classes.description: Validates that the slug in the query is not null or empty.

classes.name: Details.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the retrieval of an article based on the slug and returns an envelope or throws a not found exception.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Processes the query to fetch article data asynchronously and returns an ArticleEnvelope or throws an exception if not found.
